src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_cd119_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 119th Congress's districts (its file says session 119).
rec: Indiana General Assembly: House Bill 1581 (2021), redistricting, reprinted 2021-09-23 (copy at All About Redistricting)
cd119 is identical to cd118. A mid-decade congressional redraw (HB 1032) passed the House in 2025 and failed in the Senate on 2025-12-11, so nothing changed.
